Third, electronegativity measures the ability of an atom to attract a shared pair of electrons in a chemical bond. This trend increases as you move from left to right across the periodic table. Finally, remember that metallic character decreases as you move right. gradedQuestions.question: What is the SI unit of impulse in classical mechanics?
options: Newton-second (N·s)
Joule-second (J·s)
Watt (W)
Pascal (Pa)
gradedQuestions.explanation: Impulse equals force multiplied by time (J = F·Δt), so its SI unit is Newton-second (N·s), equivalent to kg·m/s.

gradedQuestions.question: If the kinetic energy of a moving particle is quadrupled, its linear momentum changes by a factor of:
gradedQuestions.explanation: Since K = p² / (2m), p = sqrt(2mK). Quadrupling K increases momentum p by sqrt(4) = 2.

gradedQuestions.question: Which phenomenon conclusively demonstrates the transverse nature of light waves?
options: Diffraction
Interference
Polarization
Refraction
gradedQuestions.explanation: Only transverse waves can be polarized because their oscillations occur perpendicular to the direction of wave propagation.
